themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Niemeyer-era information surface: deep interior shadow, terracotta structure, and a single wash of pool turquoise cutting through disciplined columns of text.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Niemeyer poured concrete into type. A terracotta grid holds everything upright while one cool turquoise seam runs through the columns like water beneath a civic pavilion.
Disciplined columns of IBM Plex Sans hold the structure together beneath the canopy.
Cormorant Garamond · IBM Plex Sans · 2px radius

themes.name: Wet Lacquer
themes.description: Rain-slicked surfaces and gallery stillness — a cinematic evening where vivid images float on deep, polished warmth.

props.text: Rain-slicked surfaces. Gallery stillness. Vivid images hover on deep polished warmth — a cinematic evening frozen mid-breath.

themes.name: Gilt & Grain
themes.description: Art Deco glamour filtered through a print journalist's eye — geometric gold ornament pressed into warm newsprint, editorial hierarchy made ornate.

props.text: Gold leaf pressed into newsprint. Art Deco rigour meets the compositing room floor — ornament as information, hierarchy as spectacle.

themes.name: Fired & Measured
themes.description: Swiss grid precision meets hand-glazed ceramic surfaces — mineral blues and terracotta held in tight typographic geometry.

props.text: Mineral blue. Terracotta burn. Every column ruled by the grid, every surface touched by the kiln.

themes.name: Aqua Bloom
themes.description: Y2K optimism translated through dawn's soft breath — acid aqua meets blush, scattered like morning browser windows catching the first light.

props.text: Browser windows scattered across morning light. Acid aqua and blush collide like a forgotten Y2K screensaver finally waking up — soft, electric, and unafraid.

themes.name: Azulejo Nocturne
themes.description: Cobalt geometry on bone-white tin glaze, drawn inward by late-night quiet — the courtyard after the last lamp goes out.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Cobalt geometry pressed into bone-white silence. The courtyard after the last lamp goes out — every tile a small proof that order and dark can share a wall.

themes.name: Harbour Tin
themes.description: Baltic winter light filtered through sea fog — tall cold type, duotone imagery, and a single red warehouse burning through the mist.

props.text: Baltic winter light filtered through sea fog. One red warehouse burns through the grey. Everything else holds its breath.
The fog does not lift — it simply becomes familiar.
